  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CRS" name="CRS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CRS" name="Defective computer received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DefectiveComputer" messageRef="Msg_DefectiveComputer"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckDefect" name="Check defect">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendCostCalculation" name="Send repair cost calculation" messageRef="Msg_CostCalculation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_CustomerDecision" name="Customer decision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_CostsAccepted" name="Costs accepted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CostsAccepted" messageRef="Msg_CostAccepted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_CostsRejected" name="Costs not accepted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CostsRejected" messageRef="Msg_CostRejected"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RepairDeclined" name="Repair declined by customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairMerge" name="Repair start">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairSplit" name="Start repair activities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckHardware" name="Check hardware">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairHardware" name="Repair hardware">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestHardware" name="Test hardware functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckSoftware" name="Check software">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfigureSoftware" name="Configure software">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSoftware" name="Test software functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairJoin" name="Repair activities completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ErrorCheck" name="Error detected?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RepairFinished" name="Repair completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_CRS" targetRef="Task_CheckDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckDefect" targetRef="SendTask_SendCostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="SendTask_SendCostCalculation" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision" targetRef="Catch_CostsAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision" targetRef="Catch_CostsRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Catch_CostsRejected" targetRef="EndEvent_RepairDeclined"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Catch_CostsAccepted" targetRef="Gateway_RepairMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairMerge" targetRef="Gateway_RepairSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_CheckHardware" targetRef="Task_RepairHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_RepairHardware" targetRef="Task_TestHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_TestHardware" targetRef="Gateway_RepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_CheckSoftware" targetRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware" targetRef="Task_TestSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_TestSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_RepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorCheck" targetRef="Gateway_RepairMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_RepairFinished"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CostCalculation" name="Repair cost calculation"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ComputerRepair" name="Computer repair" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_ComputerRepair">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_ComputerArrives</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CostDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_NotRepaired</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CRS" name="CRS">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RepairStart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckSoftware</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfigureSoftware</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TestSoftware</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RepairJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ErrorCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_RepairFinished</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ComputerArrives" name="Customer request started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_BringInComputer" name="Bring in defective computer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckDefect" name="Check defect">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendCostCalculation" name="Hand out repair cost calculation" messageRef="Msg_CostCalculation">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CostDecision" name="Costs acceptable?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeComputerHome" name="Take computer home">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotRepaired" name="Computer not repaired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairStart" name="Repair start">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairSplit" name="Start repair activities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckHardware" name="Check hardware">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairHardware" name="Repair hardware">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestHardware" name="Test hardware functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckSoftware" name="Check software">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfigureSoftware" name="Configure software">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSoftware" name="Test software functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairJoin" name="Repair activities completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ErrorCheck" name="Error detected?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RepairFinished" name="Repair finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_ComputerArrives" targetRef="Task_BringInComputer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_BringInComputer" targetRef="Task_CheckDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_CheckDefect" targetRef="SendTask_SendCostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="SendTask_SendCostCalculation" targetRef="Gateway_CostDecision"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairStart" targetRef="Gateway_RepairSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_CheckHardware" targetRef="Task_RepairHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_RepairHardware" targetRef="Task_TestHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_TestHardware" targetRef="Gateway_RepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_CheckSoftware" targetRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware" targetRef="Task_TestSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_TestSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_RepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorCheck" targetRef="Gateway_RepairStart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_RepairFinished"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
